text:
lia: heads-up — CI perf reg on host CPU for small requests, 95th token latency up ~18% since yesterday deploy. flamegraph: https://perf.internal/reports/171305 :eyes:
ashwin: can you paste the top hot paths? thinking tokenization or grpc framing
lia: top lines from pprof (host preprocess):
```
# top 10
1  32.4%  parse::tokenize
2  18.1%  ingress::parse_frame
3  9.3%   http2::writev_coalesce
4  7.8%   kv_cache::lookup->evict path
```
ashwin: kv eviction at host? that would blow latency due to reparse+memcopy :grimacing:
noah: saw similar last month — batching heuristics changed to more eager flushes; could be smaller batch windows now. any change in autobatcher config? @perf-bot can you show recent rollout
perf-bot: rollout: autoscaler v2.4 deployed 1713052000 -> changed mini-batch timeout 10ms->5ms for low latency tier
maya: ^that's likely it. reducing timeout reduces batching efficiency and increases per-request host work (tokenize+parse repeated).
lia: repro script: curl -> send 1 prompt 32 tokens repeatedly. numbers:
```
before: p95 48ms
after: 58ms (+21%)
cpu profile shows parse/tokenize spikes per request
```
ashwin: short-term patch: re-enable 10ms timeout for low-latency tier and enable KV prefetch on ingress for repeated tokens. can we test with canary? :thumbsup:
noah: also propose small micro-optimization: avoid full parse for simple text-only requests. add fast-path: if content-type == text/plain && no tools -> minimal tokenization.
maya: agree. add unit test and perf harness. I'll own canary. lia can you run perf harness with the timeout reverted + kv-prefetch on canary and post numbers?
lia: running now, will post results in ~30m. initial dev build shows p95 down to 50ms on canary (w/ kv prefetch), still above baseline but moving in right direction.
ashwin: great. follow-up: we should also instrument kernel selection — longer sequences still shifting kernels due to shorter batch windows. add metric: kernel_chosen and batch_size histograms to telemetry.
noah: logging proposal approved. small checklist: revert timeout -> canary, fast-path opt, kv-prefetch, kernel telemetry. plan for full rollout if canary p95 < 52ms and cpu delta < +5%.
lia: adding notes to triage doc: https://docs.internal/triage/171305-token-kv
maya: thanks all. tagging @oncall to watch for regressions during rollout.
oncall: ack — will monitor tail latencies and error rates
